name: whiteb0x Motion Identity
description: Animation primitives that define how the brand moves. The signature is 'aureate-breathe' — a 4-second three-layer gold text-shadow pulse on hero typography. All entrance motions are deliberate and short (≤600ms) — this brand does not over-animate.
principles: Reduced amplitude (y:24, not y:60) — feels engineered, not template-GSAP
Deliberate durations (≤600ms) — no luxurious slow-mo unless it's the signature breathe
Apple-style precise easing — not snappy, not bouncy, just considered
Respect prefers-reduced-motion — fall back to instant on reduced
One signature animation only — the breathe — everything else supports it

precise.description: Apple-style refined deceleration. Default for layout transitions.
precise.use: Layout entrances, modal open/close, drawer transitions

inOut.use: Breathing animations, glow pulses, ambient loops

mechanical.use: Button hover, focus ring, color transitions

linear.description: Constant velocity. Used for continuous rotation and shaders.
linear.use: 3D cube rotation, topo shader time uniform

instant.use: Color changes on stateful elements, prefers-reduced-motion fallback

fast.use: Hover states, focus ring appearance, opacity tweaks

base.use: Default transition duration, layout shifts, color changes

slow.use: Entrance reveals, hero animations, section transitions

ambient.use: Breathing loops, glow pulses (the signature breathe)

primary.name: fade-up
primary.description: Default entrance for content blocks. Subtle, deliberate.

stagger.description: Slight stagger creates rhythm without dragging the eye

signature.name: aureate-breathe
signature.description: The brand's signature animation. A three-layer gold text-shadow that pulses opacity over 4 seconds. Used on the hero wordmark and selected focal text. Reads as: the mark is alive, the studio is awake, precision is breathing.

lenis.rationale: Existing Lenis config — converging pattern but justified by the deliberate cinematic feel. If we ever change, document why.

reveal.description: Section reveals trigger when 85% visible (matches existing GSAP scroll trigger)

cube_rotation.description: Irrational ratios prevent flat-face alignment moments. Don't change to 1:1:1.

breath_scale.description: Matches the 4s text breathe — cube and text breathe at the same rate (heartbeat sync)

reducedMotion.fallback_policy: Disable all entrance animations, breathing, and ambient loops. Keep hover/focus transitions (instant or 100ms max).
